description: Machine-readable form of the CAM verdict standard (https://github.com/kau17033/cam-product-viability-standard). This schema describes the judgment logic only; there is no hosted API. A runnable implementation is the free browser-based checker at https://cam-proof-demo-owned-20261028.ki4033322.workers.dev/ — inputs never leave the browser.

allowableCpa.description: margin - targetProfit. An arithmetic ceiling for ad spend, not a prediction of real CPA.

incomplete.description: True when any money item is missing; no verdict is issued.

margin.description: Profit per order = price - (cost + shipping + fee + returnReserve + otherVariable). Null when incomplete.

verdict.description: Null when status is INCOMPLETE. A judgment exists only for complete money inputs. For positive margin, TEST_CANDIDATE additionally requires all five checks to pass; failed/unconfirmed checks produce HOLD.

status.description: INCOMPLETE means no CAM verdict was issued; VERDICT means the verdict field is one of the three canonical judgments.

criteria.description: The pass line, fixed in advance. Reference gate used by the CAM demo.

product.description: One product to judge. All money items are required; if any money item is missing, the result is incomplete and no verdict is issued.

estimateDate.description: Date the cost estimate was made

returnReserve.description: Return reserve: expected cost of returns per order. Always counted, never optional.

shipping.description: Shipping borne by the seller per order

title: CAM Product Viability Check — input/output schema
